summary: Every 100 ms, detect exited children and update the catalog.

steps.action: try_wait every running child under the catalog mutex
properties: a child whose wait fails is not assumed exited, to avoid signalling a reused PID

steps.action: exited Pi pane: mark it unavailable; Session stays open
exited terminal pane: archive shell and prune layout in one transaction
Session with no remaining panes: archive it (reason shell_exited)
repair invariants: Workspace sessions and the home session
